 Kyle Kuzma puts up 27 points in loss to Celtics 
 by Garrett Ball | Bucks Correspondent | Mon, Nov 9th 2026, 9:36am EST 
 Kyle Kuzma scored 27 points (10-17 FG, 6-13 3P, 1-2 FT) with four rebounds, a steal, and two blocks in the Bucks’ 117-97 loss to the Celtics on Sunday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 It was the best performance of the season by the veteran forward, who led the Bucks in scoring on Sunday. It’s been a tough start to the year for Kuzma, who is averaging a career low 11.6 points per game so far this season.
